purpose: Contextual guidance for the OCR-to-TeX agent. These are not automatic replacements.
decision_policy: Never modify a source doc_N.md file.
Apply a repair only when local mathematical or linguistic context supports it.
Log every semantic repair with source page, before, after, reason, rule_id, and confidence.
If two readings remain plausible, preserve the OCR text and add an uncertainty instead of guessing.

rules.symptom: The letter O and digit 0 are confused inside mathematics.
rules.guidance: Use equation semantics, nearby definitions, repeated notation, and operand type. Preserve standard big-O notation O(...).
rules.unsafe_example: Replacing every O with 0 by pattern.

rules.symptom: A subscript marker, group, or comma-separated index is missing or attached to the wrong symbol.
rules.guidance: Compare repeated occurrences of the same symbol and the role of the index before repairing x i, x_i, x_{i,j}, or indexed roots.

rules.symptom: An exponent or footnote marker is mistaken for ordinary baseline text.
rules.guidance: Distinguish mathematical powers from prose footnotes using the surrounding expression and repeated notation.

rules.symptom: OCR produces unbalanced or incorrectly nested sqrt, frac, numerator, denominator, or root-index groups.
rules.guidance: Repair only when balancing delimiters and mathematical equivalence are supported by adjacent derivation or repeated formulae.

rules.symptom: Parentheses, braces, brackets, absolute-value bars, or display-math delimiters are missing or mismatched.
rules.guidance: Balance TeX syntax while preserving the intended mathematical grouping; report any semantic delimiter change.

rules.symptom: A mathematical symbol is recognized as a visually similar letter or malformed TeX command.
rules.guidance: Use the domain context and repeated notation. Typical candidates include l/1, I/l, nu/v, rho/p, epsilon/e, minus/dash, and prime/apostrophe.

rules.symptom: Names, quotation marks, apostrophes, dashes, or accented words contain obvious mojibake.
rules.guidance: Repair only recognizable encoding corruption. Preserve uncertain proper names and report them for review.

rules.symptom: A sentence, word, formula, list item, theorem, or proof is split across adjacent OCR pages.
rules.guidance: Use neighboring pages to join the structure once. Do not duplicate either side of the page boundary.

rules.symptom: OCR Markdown heading depth does not match the semantic chapter/section hierarchy.
rules.guidance: Infer TeX chapter, section, subsection, appendix, theorem-like block, or unnumbered heading from the document hierarchy and table of contents.

rules.symptom: An image, caption, or group of related images is separated or ordered incorrectly.
rules.guidance: Associate captions using page order and labels. Use one figure for a single image and minipages only for genuinely related side-by-side images.
